---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

leaders <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(yearID, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    full_name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    steroid_era_active = first_year <= 2009 & last_year >= 1994
  ) |>
  select(full_name, career_home_runs, first_year, last_year, steroid_era_active) |>
  mutate(full_name = fct_reorder(full_name, career_home_runs))

ggplot(leaders, aes(x = career_home_runs, y = full_name, fill = steroid_era_active)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "steelblue", "TRUE" = "firebrick"),
    labels = c("Not active in steroid era", "Active in steroid era"),
    name = "Steroid era overlap"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Career Home Run Leaders by Steroid-Era Overlap",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

barry_bonds <- Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(barry_bonds, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds: Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
